BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; STILLWATER VETERANS MEMORIAL. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to expand veterans memorial in Stillwater.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; STILLWATER VETERANS MEMORIAL.

$350,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the Stillwater Veterans Memorial to expand the memorial to veterans of the United States armed forces at Stillwater Veterans Memorial in the city of Stillwater.
additions: $350,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the Stillwater Veterans Memorial to expand the memorial to veterans of the United States armed forces at Stillwater Veterans Memorial in the city of Stillwater.
